Not listed in the official requirements.

Complete degree certificate in English (bachelor's and, for a PhD with a master's, master's). Notarised copies at application, attested documents after admission. Final-year students may start with a transcript copy.
Complete transcript in English. Notarised copies at application, attested documents after admission. Final-year students may apply with a copy and send the official one on admission.
Statement of purpose, a 500 to 1,000 word essay on your motivation, background, career goals and study plans.
Research statement of 1 to 3 pages on your past research and what you want to work on. You must write it yourself without faculty help.
At least two letters; one from a course instructor or research advisor and one from a current or previous work supervisor. Referees are emailed after you submit.
Three letters; at least one from a course instructor or research advisor and one from a current or previous work supervisor. Referees are emailed after you submit.

TOEFL iBT 90, IELTS Academic 6.5 or EmSAT English 1550, valid during the application. A waiver can be requested if all your schooling and degrees were in English in a reference English-speaking country.
GRE General score may be submitted.
GRE is needed if you apply with a bachelor's degree only (at least 150 verbal, 150 quantitative, 3 writing); optional with a master's degree.
If you list online Math or programming courses in the application, upload their completion certificates.
